plan.scope: Actual serial SoundTouchTransport5positional sources; original is exact sum of4different known synthetic stems. Proposed unmuted recombination criterion, not reference-measured Serato sonic behavior or source model quality.

fixture.original: samplewise Float32 sum of four stems; no separation model

plan.acceptanceRationale: Preserve the existing3percent stem reconstruction budget when comparing the processed original to the sum of processed complementary stems. Shared command frames alone do not imply waveform coherence.
plan.capture: Whole3s/quantum rounded output all10channels; every sample finite; original PCM retained exclusive; no gain fit/delay fit/phase repair/trim.

snapshot.memoryLimit: Whole caller-provided PCM plus bounded16epochs; opaque DSP heaps not counted.
snapshot.pcmOwnership: Descriptors are snapshotted; PCM arrays are borrowed immutable data for the transport lifetime. The worklet owns transferred storage.
snapshot.clockRetention: Last two applied anchors; older queries reject explicitly.
snapshot.scope: Forward pull-based experiment; nominal output endpoint, not measured audible source position or proved EOS tail preservation.
